scenes.text: Who works in the hottest room of the house?
Very often, women and girls, cooking over a fire in a small, smoky kitchen, in the middle of a heatwave.
A study in Nepal calls it a daily thermal labour, heaviest for women in the poorest single-room homes.
And when heat makes people ill, the extra caring usually falls on women and girls: fetching water, nursing the sick, minding children home from school.
Cleaner stoves, cooler kitchens, shared care.
